# Vendored: esp-gpio-tool chip data

Per-GPIO chip data from Espressif's official
[esp-gpio-tool](https://github.com/espressif/esp-gpio-tool)
(`esp_gpio_tool_cli/targets/*.yaml`), used by our test suite to
cross-validate the pin data on esp32pin.com against Espressif's own dataset.

- Upstream: https://github.com/espressif/esp-gpio-tool
- Vendored from commit: `a1bcdb2fe2edc50c9c88e5506dc2a841d9888dd4` (2026-07-13)
- License: Apache-2.0 (see [LICENSE](./LICENSE))
- Copyright 2024-2026 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD

Do not edit these files. To refresh, copy the `targets/` YAMLs from a new
upstream checkout and update the commit hash above.
